usedFor: Paystack holds payments and subscriptions, and Google Docs records each “New Refund” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Refund” in Paystack, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each refund is written into a doc tab, giving finance a written trail.

watchOut: Paystack triggers such as “New Refund” are polling, so entries reach the doc after a scheduled check.
